description: Defines the ResourceStatus interface and related enums and classes for representing the status of a resource (e.g., client connection, source, target) within the Eclipse Ditto project. Includes JSON serialization details and resource type identification.

classes.name: ResourceStatus
classes.description: Interface representing the status of a resource, including methods to retrieve resource type, client ID, address, status, status details, and timestamp. Extends Jsonifiable for JSON serialization.

classes.name: ResourceStatus.ResourceType
classes.description: Enum defining resource types: SOURCE, TARGET, CLIENT, UNKNOWN, with methods for name retrieval and lookup.

classes.name: ResourceStatus.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class defining JSON field definitions for ResourceStatus serialization, including schema version, type, status, client, address, status details, and in-state timestamp.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the resource address, if available.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current connectivity status of the resource.

methods.name: getStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns optional details about the resource status.

methods.name: getInStateSince
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the resource entered the current state.
